summary: The PR aims to optimize migrations by combining CreateModel and AlterModelManagers into a single CreateModel operation. However, there are multiple redundant checks and no additional tests.

issues.description: There are multiple identical blocks of code checking for AlterModelManagers, which violates the DRY principle and makes the code harder to maintain.
No new tests have been added to verify the functionality of the combined CreateModel with managers, increasing the risk of regressions.
